region_policy.initial_navigation: 기존 격자 주도로 유지; 탐험 구역의 연결 통로부터 변형
region_policy.scene_population: 지역 예산과 영속 ID로 관리; 청크 재로딩으로 개체나 보상을 복제하지 않음
region_policy.cache_policy: 지형/패턴/소품 자원을 공유; 전역 좌표와 시드를 무제한 메시 키로 사용하지 않음

integration_notes: One ground mesh and one OPAQUE vertex-color material/primitive per chunk. Grass, gravel and ground debris are merged into that chunk. Large shared props are optional instances, canopy separately addressable.
Base variants represent scenes within 48-96-unit regions; do not randomize biome per chunk. Place variants span 2x2 chunks, share a persistent place ID.

Preserve existing villages, tutorial, outposts, 147-unit main-road grid and access paths. Example ports are centered; fit/arbitrate actual global road masks during later integration, never replace protected roads blindly.
No terrain slowdown, damage, corruption, swimming, cliffs, spawns or rewards are implemented by these models.
Place examples are authored for the listed base biome; palette changes for another biome require a separate baked material/vertex-color variant in later authoring, not one new actor per tile.
